https://jobs.ledgerly.com/senior-backend.text:
Ledgerly - Senior Backend Engineer (Payments Platform)
Ledgerly builds payment infrastructure for online marketplaces: payouts, ledgers, and reconciliation.
Level: Senior (L5). You will design and operate high-throughput payment APIs in Go and Python on Postgres and Kafka, own idempotency and exactly-once money movement, and mentor engineers.
Requirements: 5+ years building distributed backend systems; strong data modeling; experience with payments or financial ledgers is a plus.
Interview loop: coding, system design, and a values interview.
